# Saved `pw-dump` JSON, Avahi TXT, nsswitch, `/proc/net/udp`, and UFW samples for parser tests.
# `pw-dump-raop-loaded.json` / `pw-dump-no-raop.json` cover RAOP module and sink parsing.
# `pw-dump-local-sinks.json` / `pw-dump-channels-only.json` cover This PC (non-RAOP) outputs.
# `avahi-records.json` / `avahi-browse-p.txt` cover mDNS grouping and the parsable browse fallback.
